summary_en: Nippon Soda authorized acquisition of up to 700,000 shares (1.30% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 2.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13, 2026 to February 28, 2027, to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency under its medium-term management plan.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Nippon Soda's Board of Directors resolved on November 12, 2026 to acquire up to 700,000 shares of common stock, representing a maximum of 1.30% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, for a total expenditure not exceeding 2.0 billion yen. The acquisition will proceed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 13, 2026 and February 28, 2027.

The company is conducting this buyback to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency as part of its medium-term management plan titled "Shine Brightly with Chemistry. Stage III." The authorization framework does not specify a maximum acquisition price per share, leaving pricing discretion to management within the aggregate ceiling.
